{'text': '特朗普（由占士·奧斯汀·莊遜飾演）上週末意外亮相英國版《Saturday Night Live》。', 'paragraph_context': 'Donald Trump (aka James Austin Johnson) made an unexpected appearance on the U.K. version of “Saturday Night Live” this weekend.'}

{'text': '莊遜飾演的特朗普在唐寧街一場英國首相安德魯·伯納姆（由佐治·科格斯飾演）與烏克蘭總統澤連斯基（由費迪·梅雷迪斯飾演）的會談中突然現身，事緣伯納姆提及了美國總統的名字。', 'paragraph_context': 'Johnson’s Trump crashed a Downing Street meeting between U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham (played by George Fouracres) and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy (portrayed by Freddie Meredith) after Burnham uttered POTUS’ name.'}

{'text': '莊遜飾演的特朗普聲稱自己來英國是為了探望喜劇演員羅素· Brand Brand—— Brand正因強姦及性侵犯罪名受審。Brand否認所有控罪。', 'paragraph_context': 'Johnson, as Trump, claimed he was in England to see comedian and actor Russell Brand, who is currently on trial for rape and sexual assault. Brand denies the charges.'}

{'text': '「我來到這裡就是為了看我最喜愛的喜劇演員，」特朗普說。「他正在高等法院『演出』，飾演被告一角。」', 'paragraph_context': '“I’m in town to see my favorite comedian,” said Trump. “He’s performing live at the High Court in the role of defendant.”'}

{'text': '他隨即向伯納姆提出職位互換，並談到美國：', 'paragraph_context': 'He then proposed a job swap with Burnham, saying of America:'}

{'text': '「我跟你講，嗰度真係一團糟，你一定會恨死嗰份工。嗰係一份差到不得了嘅工。嗰個地方好恐怖，淨係住晒啲令人作嘔嘅人。我唔知自己點解仲要做落去。」', 'paragraph_context': '“I tell you that place is a real mess, you’re going to hate it. It’s an awful, awful job. It’s a terrible place full of disgusting people. I don’t know why I do it.”'}

{'text': '伯納姆拒絕咗佢。', 'paragraph_context': 'Burnham turned him down.'}

{'text': '「拜託啦，呢個國家已經沒救了，得我先有能力去收拾殘局，」特朗普回應道，之後又即興發揮，逐一揶揄英國多項具爭議性嘅議題。', 'paragraph_context': '“Come on, this country has gone to the dogs, and I alone can fix it,” Trump responded, then riffing on a list of controversial issues in the U.K.'}

{'text': '特朗普之後仲嘲笑自己亮相嘅呢個節目，聲稱如果由Lorne Michaels擔任行政監製嘅《SNL UK》「搵唔到任何人」去飾演美國總統，英國喜劇就「前景堪憂」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Trump later mocked the show on which he was appearing, declaring British comedy to be in a “bad situation” if the Lorne Michaels-executive-produced “SNL UK” “doesn’t have anyone” who can play the president.'}

{'text': '特朗普先後乞求伯納姆及澤連斯基同佢交換位置都失敗收場，伯納姆最後結束咗呢個環節，對澤連斯基講：「雖然情況好嚴峻，但最重要嘅係我哋所有人都要對呢個癲佬好好。」', 'paragraph_context': 'After Trump’s begging of Burnham, and then Zelenskyy, to swap positions proved futile, Burnham ended the bit, telling Zelenskyy: “As dire as things may be, what matters most is that we all be nice to this insane man.”'}
